name: Yume Tenshi ~Takujou Dennou Inmu Yuugi~
original_name: 夢・天・使 ～卓上電脳淫夢遊戯～
source:
Two girls greet you in an entertainment place. They explain the place to you and ask you to pick one of 12 girls to play a virtual situation. To finish each situation, you need to win four majong games or rich-man card games with the girl. If you manage to get all 12 girls, those two will challenge you.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
两个女孩在娱乐场所迎接你。他们向你解释这个地方，并要求你从12个女孩中挑选一个来玩虚拟场景。要完成每种情况，你需要与女孩一起赢得四场麻将游戏或富翁纸牌游戏。如果你设法集齐所有12个女孩，那两个女孩就会向你发起挑战。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]李家欢乐屋[/url]]
